title: Frontend Developer Roadmap
description: A step-by-step guide to becoming a modern frontend developer, covering the fundamentals of the web, core languages, tooling, and frameworks.

nodes.title: Web Fundamentals
nodes.description: Section covering the foundational technologies of the web before diving into tooling and frameworks.

nodes.title: How the Web Works
nodes.description: Understand the **request/response cycle**, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and what happens when you type a URL into the browser.

nodes.title: HTML
nodes.description: Learn semantic markup, document structure, forms, and accessibility basics. HTML is the skeleton of every web page.

nodes.title: Accessibility (a11y)
nodes.description: Optional but highly recommended: learn ARIA roles, keyboard navigation, and semantic HTML for inclusive interfaces.

nodes.title: CSS
nodes.description: Style web pages with selectors, the box model, layout systems (`flexbox`, `grid`), and responsive design.

resources.label: CSS-Tricks: A Complete Guide to Flexbox

nodes.title: Responsive Design
nodes.description: Use media queries, fluid units, and mobile-first principles so layouts adapt across screen sizes.

nodes.title: CSS Preprocessors & Frameworks
nodes.description: Optional: explore Sass, Tailwind CSS, or CSS Modules to scale styling on larger projects.

nodes.title: JavaScript
nodes.description: The programming language of the web. Cover variables, functions, the DOM, events, and asynchronous code (`Promises`, `async/await`).

nodes.title: DOM Manipulation
nodes.description: Select, create, and update elements; handle events; and understand event delegation and bubbling.

nodes.title: Fetch & APIs
nodes.description: Communicate with servers using the `fetch` API, handle JSON, and work with REST endpoints.

nodes.title: TypeScript
nodes.description: Optional: add static typing on top of JavaScript for safer, more maintainable codebases.

nodes.title: Tooling & Workflow
nodes.description: Section covering the developer tooling that supports modern frontend work.

nodes.title: Version Control (Git)
nodes.description: Track changes, branch, merge, and collaborate. Learn the core workflow and a platform like GitHub or GitLab.

nodes.title: Package Managers
nodes.description: Use `npm`, `pnpm`, or `yarn` to manage project dependencies and scripts.

nodes.title: Build Tools & Bundlers
nodes.description: Understand modern bundlers like **Vite** and Webpack: dev servers, hot module replacement, and production builds.

nodes.title: Linters & Formatters
nodes.description: Optional: enforce consistency with ESLint and Prettier across a team.

nodes.title: Frameworks
nodes.description: Section covering component-based UI frameworks and the ecosystem around them.

nodes.title: Pick a Framework (React / Vue / Svelte)
nodes.description: Learn a component-based framework. **React** is the most in-demand, but Vue and Svelte are excellent alternatives.

nodes.title: State Management
nodes.description: Optional: manage shared application state with tools like Redux, Zustand, or Pinia as apps grow.

nodes.title: Testing
nodes.description: Write unit and integration tests with tools like Vitest, Jest, and Testing Library.

nodes.title: Deployment
nodes.description: Ship your app to the web using platforms like Netlify, Vercel, or Cloudflare Pages with CI/CD.
